1.consolidated_definition: Estar a rey En la literatura realista-costumbrista, estar una persona desnuda, no tener nada, carecer de todo. Probablemente dearrollado este significado puertorriqueño debido al empleo irónico de la expresión isleña original.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To be at king (in the realist-costumbrista literature) To be a person naked, to have nothing, to lack everything. This meaning is probably developed in Puerto Rican due to the ironic use of the original island expression.
